properties.html: From a tank containing 100 litres of milk, 5 litres of milk is taken out and replaced with an equal amount of water. 10 litres of the resulting mixture is again taken out and replaced with an equal amount of water. Again, some amount of the mixture is taken out and replaced with an equal amount of water. If the final quantity of milk left in the tank is 68.4 litres, how much mixture was taken out in the third iteration?

properties.html: Two Alcohol solutions ‘A’ and ‘B’ are mixed in a ratio of 3 : 2. Then the volume of the resulting solution is doubled by further adding a mixture of solutions ‘A and ‘B’ that contain ‘A' and ‘B’ in the ratio of 11 : 9 to make the final solution. If Solution ‘A’ contains 60% alcohol and ‘B’ contains 70% alcohol then calculate the alcohol percentage in the final solution.

properties.html: A milkman has 10 litres of pure milk in his container. He sold the milk at the cost price but he mixed 1-litre water in his container after selling every 2 litres of milk. He went to a colony and sold 2 litres of milk in every house. The houses are numbered 1, 2, 3........and so on. How many houses were in the colony if he finished the milk just after being sold to the last house?
